critical_code_review_comments: Projection.jsx run() uses JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(scenario)) to clone for the no-Roth comparison run; deep-clone-on-every-projection works but a shallow clone of just scenario.roth would be cheaper since only roth.enabled is flipped.

Projection.jsx update() also does a full JSON deep-clone per keystroke; with a 350ms debounce on run() this is fine but the clone happens unconditionally even for no-op updates. Consider Immer or a structural setter if the scenario grows.
ProjectionControls memoizes keyAccounts via filter (per the review request) - the filter predicate is inline; if the predicate identity matters elsewhere, hoist to a constant. Non-blocking.
AIInsights.jsx now strips id when posting history to /insights/chat (maps to {role, content}) - verified by the working multi-turn flow. Good.

Projection.jsx has a leftover useMemo dependency 'mcResult' that pulls portfolio_vol/portfolio_mean correctly (v2 keys) - matches the agent note. Other v1 keys (portfolio_volatility/portfolio_avg_return) are no longer referenced in this file. Clean.

Projection.jsx orchestrator is now 191 lines (down from 406) - within the <700 line target. ProjectionPanels.jsx hosts the four extracted components in a single file; if it grows past ~700 lines it should split per-component.
